the restored impeccable items 1-50 exposed #154: ::selection, scrollbar-color, caret-color and tabular figures were all missing, so the page fell back to the OS selection blue. First attempt used var(--navy)/var(--paper) and produced navy on navy because both tokens flip with the scheme; pinned to #063171 on #eef2f8 and verified by screenshot. Added VQ-25

#24 was absent from the stylesheet: no text-wrap anywhere. Added balance on h1-h3 and pretty on p/li/dd. No earlier height-based probe detected it because balance changes line lengths, not line counts; measured last-line width instead, 82px -> 135px on a 390px viewport. Added VQ-26

#146: eight raw font-size values with no tokens, including 13.5px and 15.5px half-steps. Introduced --text-caption/small/compact/lede/body/subhead. The first mapping silently dropped .card p from 15.5px to 15px, below the mobile reading floor; caught by measuring every page and corrected to --text-lede 16px. Added VQ-27

impeccable #80/#83: 18 elements held will-change at rest, including 13 .reveal blocks that kept a layer for the whole session after animating once. Reveals now release the hint in onComplete and in the safety sweep; the story hints only while its track is near the viewport. Measured 18 -> 5 -> 0 behind the reader. Added VQ-28

impeccable #36: no spacing scale existed; 18 distinct raw px values covered margin/padding/gap. Introduced --space-1..22 on a 4-unit base and rewrote 52 declarations. VQ-13 then caught the regression the snap introduced: .section__head a went 10px -> 8px and its hit area fell to 43px, one under the 44px minimum. Reverted that one to 10px with a comment: accessibility wins over rhythm. Layout height 5947 -> 5881px, overflow still 0 on 6 pages

The hero CTA could not be clicked at any scroll offset: inactive story chapters are absolute full-stage layers that kept pointer events and sat above the live one in DOM order, so elementFromPoint always returned an invisible layer. Fixed with pointer-events:none on inactive chapters (visibility untouched so the crossfade still paints the outgoing chapter). Adding the missing :active state exposed a contrast defect: a:hover (0,1,1) outbid .button (0,1,0) and the label inherited --blue, 1.578:1 hover and 1.096:1 pressed in dark. Pinned per state in both schemes, lowest state 11.32:1
